content: No-auth kiosk-style apps on a LAN still carry risk: any device joining the network (guest phone on WiFi, compromised IoT device) has full read/write access with no audit trail; kiosk browser lockdown alone is not a security boundary and doesn't prevent local users from tampering with the underlying device. Mitigation: network segmentation (separate VLAN/guest network isolation from the app server), rate-limit/validate all write endpoints server-side, and avoid exposing the server to the public internet.
